title.zh: 气体压强的微观图景 · 撞墙的账本
title.en: The Microscopic Picture of Gas Pressure · A Ledger of Wall Hits

desc.zh: 盒子里的粒子乱撞：压强是撞墙的冲量账，温度是平均动能，速率分布自己从碰撞里长出来。
desc.en: Particles in a box bounce around: pressure is a ledger of wall impulses, temperature is mean kinetic energy, and the speed distribution grows out of collisions.
